title: Ivory kurta + navy trousers
subtitle: Pakistani seasonal staple
description: A light kurta with tailored trousers stays culturally aligned and weather-flexible for mild days.
stylingIdea: Add a beige dupatta for university or family gatherings.

title: Layered neutrals
subtitle: Western cold-weather trend
description: Grey coat, white tee, and dark denim is a high-frequency winter combination.
stylingIdea: Keep accessories minimal; add a maroon scarf if it is windy.

title: Modest navy one-piece
subtitle: Middle Eastern evening look
description: Long navy dresses remain a formal modest option that does not depend on shorts or mini silhouettes.
stylingIdea: Pair with closed shoes rather than sandals for formal events.

title: Earth-tone kaftan
subtitle: African occasion dressing
description: Olive and gold kaftans work for celebrations while remaining modest.
stylingIdea: Choose breathable fabric when temperatures are hot.

title: Clean shirt and chinos
subtitle: East Asian smart casual
description: Crisp shirts with tapered trousers stay office-appropriate without loud prints.
stylingIdea: Swap loafers for sneakers only on casual days.

title: Monochrome modest layers
subtitle: Cross-culture conservative trend
description: Black and cream layers photograph well and respect modest preferences.
stylingIdea: Use a scarf or dupatta instead of a cropped silhouette.
